text:
```yaml
name: Check CLA

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, reopened, synchronize]

jobs:
  check-cla:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Verify CLA text in PR description
        run: |
          PR_BODY="${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"
          echo "PR body:"
          echo "$PR_BODY"
          if echo "$PR_BODY" | grep -q "By submitting this pull request, I confirm that you can use, modify, copy, and redistribute this contribution, under the terms of your choice."; then
            echo "CLA text found."
          else
            echo "CLA text missing. Please add the required CLA text to the PR description."
            exit 1
          fi
```
